steps.name: Data collection
steps.note: ClinVar (paged, 23,039 records), UniProt, Ensembl VEP, AlphaFold DB.

steps.name: Preprocessing
steps.note: Sequence-validated against UniProt canonical. >=1 star, conflicts excluded. 1,886 labelled, 16,860 VUS.

steps.name: Feature engineering
steps.note: 28 features: substitution, ortholog + phyloP/GERP conservation, UniProt annotation, AlphaFold context.

steps.name: Classification
steps.note: LR, RF, XGBoost. Leave-one-gene-out CV (LR ROC-AUC 0.910). Baselines and ablation in outputs/metrics.json.

steps.name: SHAP
steps.note: TreeExplainer on full XGBoost. Global plots, direction check, per-variant explanations, ranked VUS.

steps.name: Structure
steps.note: ACTC1 R39H, PDB 9B3R, chain A. Residue-identity swap.

steps.name: Stability
steps.note: FoldX 5.1 ΔΔG for 8,984 variants at residues with pLDDT ≥ 70, used as a model feature. Per-variant API views still show the old RMSD proof of concept.

steps.name: Integrated report
steps.note: make_report exists and is not wired to the pipeline.
